hardware: Apple M4 Max, 40 Metal GPU cores, 48 GiB unified memory

excluded_initial_pairs.8: Initial stock process overlapped a Qwen benchmark.
excluded_initial_pairs.10: The pair overlapped a compilation and another benchmark.
excluded_initial_pairs.12: Another Metal probe was active and file I/O rose sharply.
excluded_initial_pairs.14: The first comparison had cache misses during other benchmarks. In the second comparison one baseline sample was 44.85 TPS versus 65.11 TPS with zero disk reads in both. Both modes were remeasured with more repetitions.
excluded_initial_pairs.20: Early pairs overlapped a competing benchmark. A later pair had a decode outlier even with zero physical reads, so it was replaced with a longer measurement.
excluded_initial_pairs.24: Initial stock TTFT was about 0.5 s higher than the same graph at 20 and 22 GiB with no measured I/O wait. Both modes were remeasured with more repetitions.

protocol: Same diagnostic server, fresh process per cap and configuration. Warmup 15/8. Points at 10, 12, 14, 20, 22, and 24 GiB additionally warm the filesystem page cache with an uncached 4000/8 request. Matched legs use the same warmup. Two uncached 4000/64 timed greedy requests (seed 42), five at 14, 20, and 24 GiB after inconsistent exploratory results, then one untimed greedy request for logits (seed 4242 selects instrumentation). Per-leg medians are reported. Decode TPS is 63 / time between first and last output token. Capture is outside the timing sample. Startup is excluded from timing. Peak managed ledger is cumulative through the measured requests including warmup and handoff. Process monitoring samples RSS and footprint every 50 ms and records lifetime physical footprint.
candidate_description: At 8–18 GiB reuse the last one or two complete prefill banks during decode. Existing prefix banks and the adopted banks use their true layer indices. At 20–24 GiB use 38 already resident MoE banks during wide prefill; no reload stage in that graph. At all caps original GGUF weights and KV settings are unchanged.
scope: Prototype qualification on one fixture, one slot, fixed managed caps and Metal. Live resizing and other prompt lengths are outside this run.

rows.calibration_reason: Two retained banks had negligible throughput impact.

Two retained banks gained about 11 percent in decode throughput, with negligible handoff time and a managed peak within cap.
Two retained banks fully cover the MoE decode, gaining about 15 percent at the same peak.
All MoE layers are resident at startup. The window binds those weights, removing about 0.82 GiB of peak usage without a substantial change in decode throughput.
